It ran on our hardware (one DGX Spark), one request at a time, through the server its package ships (python -m turion_jev.serve on vLLM), with the BF16 weights quantised to FP8 at load and --no-recheck (no second reading of unsure questions), both as in the card's own benchmark run, text only. Request time: the time at least one request was in flight, over the requests whose answers were kept.
